verdict.rationale: Sierra documents step-by-step workflows ('journeys') built in Agent Studio or the Agent SDK with sophisticated logic. That supports structured, multi-step resolution rather than a single canned answer. Nothing in the evidence explicitly says the agent asks clarifying questions or adapts troubleshooting turn by turn, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit clarifying-question behavior, documented multi-turn diagnostic/troubleshooting flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: Define step-by-step workflows for your agent from scratch, or use AI to instantly generate journeys from your existing operating procedures.
write customer journeys as code, track changes, and build sophisticated logic without giving up our development workflows
Upload SOPs, raw transcripts, or even audio interviews of subject matter experts to create customer journeys from scratch.
